title: Stockholm Sensual Festival 2026
description:
Get ready for the highly anticipated 4th Edition of the Stockholm Sensual Festival on Oct 29 – Nov 1, 2026. With more than 1500 dancers from all over the world, you can enjoy a weekend full of dancing, music, and fun in one of the most amazing cities in Scandinavia! Join us for 4 nights of parties, performances, workshops, our social dance competition, and more. Don’t miss out on this exciting event, get your ticket now!
📆 Oct 29 – Nov 1st 2026
▬▬▬▬▬▬ ✥ SSF ✥ ▬▬▬▬▬▬
💫 What to expect:
💃 +30 hours of workshops
🎩 Top International Artists
🎶 Over 3000 sqm of dance floor with Bachata, Kiz and WCS
🎉 4 Amazing Parties, pre-party, afternoon socials (pre-party included in our full pass)
🎦 Awe inspiring performances and show
🏩 All parties and workshops in one amazing venue in the heart of Solna
✨ Only a 5 minute walk to Mall of Scandinavia with over 40 restaurants and many shops
🌎 Professional Jack & Jill Competition with prizes
💃 Over 100 International Guest dancers
🎫 Full pass that includes social dance competition for WCS and Bachata.
📷 Photo sessions at Friday and Saturday Socials. Come pose and get amazing pictures.
